prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for Crown & Conquest. EXACTLY 12 isolated isometric medieval buildings in a strict 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid, equal cells, landscape 1536x1024 canvas. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, no ground plane outside tiny foundations, no text, labels, grid, borders or backdrop. Each entire building must be centred within its cell with generous 12% padding on all sides, never overlapping another cell. Camera same elevated isometric three-quarter view, detailed hand-painted realistic strategy game assets, crisp silhouettes, warm upper-left light. Faction ironfjord, age frontier: rough dark timber log longhouses, sod and thatch steep roofs, carved animal gables, simple wooden palisades, red wool pennants. Every structure uniquely follows this culture; no generic European castle substitution. Order left-to-right: Row1 main royal keep / crop farm with small granary and wheat / lumber camp with stacked logs and saw shelter / quarry workshop with stone blocks. Row2 gold mine entrance and ore carts / residential cottages cluster / infantry barracks with shields / archery range with targets. Row3 cavalry stable / siege workshop with partially built catapult / standalone defensive watchtower / short defensive wall and gate segment. All objects complete from roof tip to base. No people. High detail recognizable at mobile sprite size.
